name: phase-stepper
description: After a turn that finishes a phase or batch, suggests the next prompt in the empty prompt box (Tab to take it), with the local commit step when files are uncommitted.

doneWords.title: Extra done words
doneWords.description: Comma-separated words, in any language, that mark a phase as finished (added to done, complete, shipped and so on).

stageWords.title: Extra phase words
stageWords.description: Comma-separated words, in any language, that name a phase or batch followed by a number (added to phase, batch, stage and so on). Example: fase, etapa.
